svg.title: Take 10 µL aliquots at regular time intervals
svg.desc: Take 10 µL aliquots at regular time intervals. Take regular analytical aliquots during the 24 h thermal time course; sampling is not a separate post-heating 24 h treatment. Exact intermediate times are not tabulated. The aliquots are distinct from the retained bulk polymer. Vessel geometry, spatial arrangement and molecular or particle structure are unassigned. Source-derived conceptual operation flow; not a measured apparatus reconstruction.
